summary_en: Located in Pattaya, 331 EYE CLINIC @331 is a specialized medical center focusing on eye care and laser services with a 4.5 rating from 37 reviews. Patients highlight the clinic's modern equipment, attentive medical advice, and clear explanations from staff, all provided at an affordable price point with convenient parking.
